description: Defines the ResourceManagerMetrics class and related data structures for tracking concurrent codecs, pixel counts, and resource usage in Android media resource management.

classes.name: ResourceManagerMetrics
classes.description: Manages and tracks concurrent codecs, pixel counts, and resource usage for media clients in Android.

methods.name: notifyClientCreated
methods.description: Called when a media client is created.

methods.name: notifyClientReleased
methods.description: Called when a media client is released.

methods.name: notifyClientStarted
methods.description: Called when a media client starts.

methods.name: notifyClientStopped
methods.description: Called when a media client stops.

methods.name: notifyClientConfigChanged
methods.description: Called when a client's configuration changes.

methods.name: addPid
methods.description: Adds a process ID and UID to monitor for termination.

methods.name: getPeakConcurrentPixelCount
methods.description: Returns peak pixel count for a process.

methods.name: getCurrentConcurrentPixelCount
methods.description: Returns current pixel count for a process.
